pery_owner.text: These Georgian houses went up in the 1830s. Newtown Pery was laid out on a grid by Edmund Sexton Pery. Tall windows, fanlights over the doors, four storeys of stairs.
Frank McCourt grew up a mile from here and a world away. The lanes had one tap for the whole street. These houses had a ballroom.

pery_cat.text: A fox has let itself in through the back and sat on the good rug. It regards you as the intruder.
